name: Forest Action Facility

funder.name: Forest Action Facility (established by IUCN and KfW)

summary: Large grants for forest landscape restoration and conservation with community livelihoods in Central America, Ecuador and Peru, awarded through country calls with a concept note and full proposal stage.

geography.label: Central America, Ecuador and Peru funding windows

reporting: Grantees report on technical progress and finances periodically during implementation, as set out in the grant agreement, and FAF monitors results.

steps: Concept note for the Ecuador call

Ecuador: take part in only one concept note, as lead or partner

applicant_types.quote: FAF awards grants to non-governmental organizations (NGOs), international NGOs and intergovernmental organizations with a national office, community-based organizations, Indigenous Peoples' organizations, universities and research institutions, private-sector companies and consortia.

geography.quote: There are currently three such windows: Central America (specifically Belize, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras and Panama), Ecuador and Peru.

access.quote: FAF does not accept unsolicited proposals. Grants are awarded through open calls for proposals only.

window.quote: Each call sets a specific geographic and strategic focus, funding range, and timeline

co_finance_required.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the Applicant Organization's counterpart contribution will be at least 20% of total project costs.

reporting.quote: FAF requires periodic technical and financial reporting throughout implementation and conducts ongoing monitoring to ensure accountability for the results delivered.

effort.quote: Send the Concept Note as a PDF signed by the legal representative, together with the FAF Costs and Financing Template (Excel), to contact@forestactionfacility.org by 12 November 2026 at 23:59 (mainland Ecuador time).
Shortlisted applicants will be invited to submit a Full Proposal in accordance with the FAF Full Proposal Template.

eligibility.quote: If the company is the Applicant Organization, the counterpart contribution is 50% of total project costs; • If the company participates as a Subgrantee or partner in a component, the counterpart contribution is 50% of the costs of that commercial component; the rest of the project keeps the general 20% counterpart contribution.
The area under direct intervention must be at least 1,000 hectares.
Anywhere in mainland Ecuador: the Coast, the Highlands (Sierra) and the Amazon.

The Applicant Organization must be incorporated under Ecuadorian law. International NGOs and intergovernmental organizations must hold a valid registration or agreement authorizing them to operate in the country.
Where the intervention area includes territories or populations of Indigenous peoples and nationalities, the proposal must include a substantive alliance with their representative organizations
Each organization may take part in only one Concept Note, either as Applicant Organization or as partner.
The project intervention period is up to three years
Financial experience, i.e. managing amounts of this size, must be demonstrated by the Applicant Organisation, as it is responsible to FAF for managing the funds.

co_finance.quote: At least 20 % of total project costs, in cash and/or in kind (for example technical assistance, equipment or logistics).

after_award.quote: Funds are disbursed in tranches, according to project progress and against approved semi-annual reports (document 20a). The first disbursement requires signed restoration agreements for the first-year areas (section 6.3). The project is subject to financial and technical audits, and FAF carries out monitoring through sample field visits and remote verification of the intervention areas.

documents.quote: Send the Concept Note as a PDF signed by the legal representative, together with the FAF Costs and Financing Template (Excel), to contact@forestactionfacility.org by 12 November 2026 at 23:59 (mainland Ecuador time).

Annex 1: information on the Applicant Organization, including proof of legal personality. Annex 2: exclusion list checklist. Annex 3: preliminary environmental and social screening questionnaire. Annex 4: Applicant Organization declaration, signed by the legal representative.
